guard.negative_proof: tests/architecture/local-server-isolation.test.mjs: replacing SIGTERM with SIGKILL, or removing gracefulShutdown, turns the audit red. Runtime, 2026-10-24: `playwright test tests/e2e/seo.spec.ts` (9 passed, exit 0) left no astro preview behind with the setting; with the line removed the same run left one astro preview serving port 3000.

reuse_boundary: Local Playwright runs on POSIX. CI containers are discarded after the job, so the orphan never mattered there. Windows ignores gracefulShutdown and keeps Playwright's default kill.
root_cause: Playwright's webServer default shutdown SIGKILLs the runner's process group. `astro preview` runs as a daemon in its own process group, so it survived, and scripts/run-preview.mjs never got the SIGTERM that runs `astro preview stop`.
rule: Playwright stops the local preview with SIGTERM (webServer.gracefulShutdown) so the runner can stop the astro preview daemon before exiting.
title: Local Playwright must not leave an astro preview on port 3000
trigger: 2026-10-24: every local Playwright run left an astro preview on port 3000 (parent pid 1); the next run then failed "is already used" (correctly, per LSN-marketing-002) until the orphan was killed by hand.
